tools.name: ask_sales_agent
tools.description: Ask Skello a question about their products, pricing, or company, and get an answer from their own sales agent.

question.description: A single question about Skello, in the visitor's own words.

tools.name: compare_to_competitor
tools.description: Ask Skello's sales agent for a factual comparison with a named competitor, grounded in the company's knowledge base. Returns text; unavailable competitor facts remain unknown.

tools.name: get_implementation_timeline
tools.description: Ask Skello's sales agent about documented implementation timelines for the visitor's requirements. Returns text guidance, not a guaranteed delivery date.

requirements.description: Implementation scope, team size, integrations, and other relevant requirements.

tools.name: get_integration_status
tools.description: Ask Skello's sales agent whether an integration is supported and at what level. Returns a knowledge-based text answer; undocumented support is unknown.

integration.description: The product or service to integrate with.

tools.name: get_migration_path
tools.description: Ask Skello's sales agent for documented steps and limitations when migrating from an existing system. Returns guidance as text.

current_system.description: The current product or system the visitor wants to migrate from.
